meta.title: Fix GitHub API rate limiting in chess workflow by replacing API calls with local file storage
meta.body_summary: Replace GitHub API calls for chess workflow with local file storage to avoid rate limiting, using files for recent moves, leaderboard, and last mover tracking.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot replaced API calls with local files to fix rate limiting; maintainer questioned testing but merged after Copilot's detailed response; no formal review or benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 186 changed lines concentrated in one workflow file, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a focused, low-risk performance fix that was quickly merged after maintainer trust in Copilot's testing assertions.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer timburgan questioned whether the change was thoroughly tested and whether the current game would continue seamlessly; Copilot responded with detailed assurances and a follow-up commit.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate GitHub API rate limiting by using local file I/O, resulting in instant operations versus slow API calls.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Replacing a remote API data source with local file storage in a simple workflow is within Copilot's capability; the merge hinged on maintainer trust in Copilot's testing assertions rather than evidence.

core_change_summary.description: In .github/workflows/chess.yml, replaced calls to @octokit.list_issues() with local file reads/writes to chess_games/recent_moves.txt, leaderboard.txt, and last_mover.txt to avoid GitHub API rate limits. Added error handling for file operations.
change_trajectory: Main commit: replaced API calls with local files, added three new text files for data storage.
Follow-up commit: fixed last_mover.txt to match current game state.
